test_title: PYST 26: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - Reasoning (Held On: 16 Jun, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Which of the following letter-clusters should replace # and % so that the pattern and relationship followed between the letter-cluster pair on the left side of :: is the same as that on the right side of :: ?

# : MRN :: HMI : %
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/15d4e688c8bdc2766cb74c67a7c0d12a85a1e60bc448f376b860b7949a5ae586.png] 

The logic followed here is:

Given: # : MRN :: HMI : %

Option 1) # = LPR, % = JHG → LPR : MRN :: HMI : JHG

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1beeb403fb50dd547809f114a65e1543f95e78bb7e6aabfa25c354b5e1cbab3c.png] 

Option 2) # = KLJ, % = KHI → KLJ : MRN :: HMI : KHI

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7ffe7e8318d71e2248e8723ff8cae7f12899d18f44471cab2e35ee6993518d23.png] 

Option 3) # = PUQ, % = EJF → PUQ : MRN :: HMI : EJF

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/48c1a9dd07b8e448a6ff49760c931f342e31b609e7d6b90818396b5dbd811252.png] 

Option 4) # = JIQ, % = FDJ → JIQ : MRN :: HMI : JIQ

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/80a7c3c9924044fc5d53dc310fd470b2eec065ff41c13fdc14fa08e297f9fb90.png] 

Hence, "Option 3" is the correct answer.
